items.title: The Open Question Under Cintas Stock's Price
items.summary: Cintas (CTAS) has raised its profit forecast for fiscal 2027, and meeting it depends on its margins widening further. At 40.1 times earnings, against 22.1 for the S&P 500, the share price appears to assume the forecast holds. Cintas does not charge customers fuel surcharges, so how much higher fuel costs it can absorb is not settled yet.

items.title: 3 Chemical Stocks Bucking the Dividend Cut Trend While Peers Slash Payouts
items.summary: While Dow and LyondellBasell handed shareholders painful dividend cuts, a handful of chemical names kept raising their payouts through the same downcycle. The structural reasons behind that divide reveal which corner of the sector actually belongs in a retirement portfolio.

items.title: Nobody Cancels This Income: Rollins, Rentokil and Ecolab
items.summary: Pest control and sanitation contracts renew whether markets cooperate or not, yet two of the three companies discussed here have lost nearly half their value this year while their customers keep paying. The business case and the share price are telling very different stories right now.

items.title: Nobody Cancels These Contracts: Rollins, Rentokil and Ecolab
items.summary: Pest control and sanitation companies sell contracts that customers keep renewing even when share prices collapse, and two of these three stocks are down sharply this year while their retention numbers barely flinched.

items.title: 3 Industrial Stocks You’ve Never Heard of With 25+ Years of Dividend Increases
items.summary: Most dividend growth watchlists stop at consumer staples brands you already know, but three industrial compounders have quietly raised their payouts every year for over a quarter century while making things most investors never think about.

items.title: 10 Years Later: 5 Low-Risk Stocks for the Next Year
items.summary: Looking back at how five stocks picked specifically to beat the market over just the next year have now fared 10 years later.

items.title: Ecolab (ECL) Stock May Be Fully Priced After Its 59% Run
items.summary: Ecolab has delivered a strong share price outcome in recent years, and that kind of performance naturally raises a simple question for you as an investor. Is the current valuation still grounded in the cash flows that the business can generate, or has sentiment moved ahead of the underlying economics? items.title: Ecolab Director Eric Mark Green Buys $1 Million Stock. What Does This Mean for Investors?
items.summary: Green expanded his direct position by 87%, bringing total holdings to 7,947 shares valued at $2.19 million as of the transaction date.
